view.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall shelves stacked with black crates and white boxes. A person in a yellow safety vest walks toward the camera. Two orange forklifts are parked in the background. The floor has blue lines, and red safety blocks are visible. Lighting is industrial overhead.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Wearing a yellow reflective vest over a dark jacket, blue jeans, and black work boots. Walking forward with hands in pockets. Partially obscures foreground. Visible from waist down.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Orange forklift on left side of aisle, partially obscured by person. Driver visible but blurred. Stands on concrete floor near pallets. Appears stationary.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Second orange forklift further back, centered in aisle. Facing away from camera. On concrete floor. Appears stationary.

objects.label: warehouse shelf
objects.observation: Tall metal shelving unit on left, filled with black plastic crates. Extends vertically out of frame. Supported by metal frame. Contacts floor at base.

objects.label: warehouse shelf
objects.observation: Tall metal shelving unit on right, holding white boxes and black crates. Extends vertically. Supported by metal frame. Contacts floor at base.

objects.label: red safety block
objects.observation: Red rectangular block with textured surface on right side of aisle. Freestanding on concrete floor. No visible attachments.

objects.label: pallet
objects.observation: Wooden pallet supporting black crates under left shelf. Visible at bottom left. Contacts floor. Supports crates above.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s5-35448", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
